# ItineraryStopEmbedded

## Summary

The compact stop row used in the itinerary list: category-colored rail and dot, location name, day/time/category meta chips, and an `~$N` cost chip when the stop has an `estimatedCost`. Category color comes from `categoryStyle` so the rail, dot, and chips stay in one hue.

## Usage

```ts
ItineraryStop.embedded = ItineraryStopEmbedded;
```
